title: Pocket money
description: Ask how many weeks. Cast each input to a whole number with int() (this is called casting). For each week, read how much was saved (whole pounds). If it was more than £{{a0}}, print e.g. "[[out:0:0]]". At the end print the total, like: [[out:0:1]]
solution:
weeks = int(input("Weeks: "))
total = 0
for week in range(1, weeks + 1):
    saved = int(input("Saved: "))
    total = total + saved
    if saved > {{a0}}:
        print("Great saving in week", week)
print("Total saved (£):", total)
